dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: This is the town square! Three people with ! over their heads need help.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Rust lost his gears at the SHIPWRECK. West.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Echo wants someone dumb enough to climb the SUMMIT. North. (That's you.)

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Moxie wants the JUNKYARD robots' crates smashed. East.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Do all three and you'll have enough CRED for the BIG GATE on the south beach.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Behind it is the Sludge King. He's... fine. Totally fine. (｡ᵕ ◞ _◟)
